user.title: Create an aligned cover group
user.description: Group side-by-side shades so their bottom edges stay level.

pico.name: Pico remote (optional)
pico.description:
Paired Picos can start and stop grouped shades at the exact same time, keeping the hemlines level more precisely than sending each shade its own command.

To use this, pair a Lutron Pico on the Caseta bridge with exactly these shades. Its buttons are disabled in Home Assistant by default, so enable them on the Pico's device page first.

data_description.pico_open: Named “On” in Home Assistant. Not “Raise”, which is a small arrow button.
data_description.pico_close: Named “Off” in Home Assistant. Not “Lower”, which is a small arrow button.

data_description.name: For example, “Living Room Aligned”.
data_description.covers: The side-by-side shades to keep level. Each must support setting a position and stopping.

shade.title: {name} (shade {index} of {count})
shade.description: Where is this shade's bottom edge (hemline) when fully open and when fully closed? Measure every shade from the same point, such as inches from the floor.

travel.title: Travel time
travel.description: How long does {name}, the tallest shade, take to go from fully closed to fully open? All shades in the group are assumed to move at the same speed.

error.pico_incomplete: Choose all three Pico buttons, or none.
error.closed_not_below_open: The closed height must be below the open height.
error.cover_unsupported: Every shade must support setting a position and stopping.
error.pico_duplicate: Choose a different button for each Pico role.
error.ranges_do_not_overlap: This shade's open-to-closed range doesn't overlap the other shades'. Every shade's range must share some height.
